sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: During an Oval Office meeting with congressional Republicans a few days ago, it didn't take President Trump long to turn to his favorite subject,
sentences.zh: 几天前，在椭圆形办公室与国会共和党人会面时，特朗普总统没花多长时间就转向了他最喜欢的话题，

sentences.en: his hatred for the chairman of the Federal Reserve, Jay Powell.
sentences.zh: 即他对美联储主席杰伊·鲍威尔的厌恶。

sentences.en: In fact, during the meeting, Trump proudly showed off the draft of a letter that would fire Powell for good.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在会面期间，特朗普自豪地展示了一封将彻底解雇鲍威尔的信件草稿。

sentences.en: It's the latest chapter in a dysfunctional relationship that has major implications not just for the American economy, but for the global economy.
sentences.zh: 这是一段失调关系的最新篇章，它不仅对美国经济，而且对全球经济都具有重大影响。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with my colleague, Colby Smith, about what's really at the heart of Washington's ugliest drama,
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的同事科尔比·史密斯一起探讨华盛顿最丑陋闹剧的核心究竟是什么，

sentences.en: Trump versus Powell.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对阵鲍威尔。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月17日，星期四。

sentences.en: Colby, nice to have you.
sentences.zh: 科尔比，很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So this is an episode about some pretty heavy-duty topics.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一期关于一些相当沉重话题的节目。

sentences.en: Monetary policy, interest rates, tariffs.
sentences.zh: 货币政策、利率、关税。

sentences.en: But really, at its core, it's an episode about a toxic personal relationship between the president of the United States and the country's most powerful economic official.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，其核心是一期关于美国总统与该国最具权力的经济官员之间有毒个人关系的节目。

sentences.en: So tell us that story of how this relationship has become so toxic.
sentences.zh: 所以给我们讲讲这段关系是如何变得如此有毒的故事吧。

sentences.en: So it's a complicated relationship, to say the absolute leaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，委婉地说，这是一个复杂的关系。

sentences.en: As you mentioned, these are two of the most powerful policymakers in the entire world, and their decisions have massive economic ramifications for the global economy,
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，这是全世界最具权力的两位决策者，他们的决定对全球经济产生了巨大的经济影响，

sentences.en: the global financial system.
sentences.zh: 对全球金融系统。

sentences.en: And at the heart of the matter, you have President Trump, who has been able to unveil all the different aspects of his economic agenda that he's campaigned on.
sentences.zh: 而在问题的核心，你拥有特朗普总统，他已经能够展示他竞选时所承诺的经济议程的所有不同方面。

sentences.en: He's been successful in pushing tariffs through.
sentences.zh: 他在强行推进关税方面取得了成功。

sentences.en: He's been successful in pushing these tax cuts through.
sentences.zh: 他在强行推进这些减税措施方面取得了成功。

sentences.en: He's been successful in cracking down on immigration.
sentences.zh: 他在打击移民方面取得了成功。

sentences.en: That's why we say this is Trump's economy.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们说这是特朗普的经济。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: He's made it his own.
sentences.zh: 他把它变成了他自己的。

sentences.en: He owns it through and through.
sentences.zh: 他自始至终拥有它。

sentences.en: And in this one area that has massive economic, political, and financial ramifications, he does not have control over that.
sentences.zh: 而在具有巨大经济、政治和金融影响的这一个领域，他对此没有控制权。

sentences.en: And that is the Fed's interest rate.
sentences.zh: 那就是美联储的利率。

sentences.en: He sees this as this blockade that is making it difficult for him to achieve what he set out to achieve on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 他认为这是一个阻碍，使他难以实现他在竞选活动中着手实现的目标。

sentences.en: And for him, the chair of the Federal Reserve, Jay Powell, he is his enemy in this process.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，美联储主席杰伊·鲍威尔在这个过程中就是他的敌人。

sentences.en: Very average mentally person.
sentences.zh: 一个精神上非常平庸的人。

sentences.en: He's an average mentally person.
sentences.zh: 他是一个精神上平庸的人。

sentences.en: We've had nonstop name calling.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了源源不断的人身攻击。

sentences.en: But we have a guy that's just a stubborn mule.
sentences.zh: 但我们有一个像顽固骡子一样的人。

sentences.en: He's referred to Chair Powell as a major loser, a numbskull.
sentences.zh: 他把鲍威尔主席称为一个彻底的失败者、笨蛋。

sentences.en: It doesn't help.
sentences.zh: 这毫无帮助。

sentences.en: He's like a knucklehead.
sentences.zh: 他就像个笨脑筋。

sentences.en: No, he's a knucklehead.
sentences.zh: 不，他是个笨脑筋。

sentences.en: Knucklehead?
sentences.zh: 笨脑筋？

sentences.en: Yeah, knucklehead.
sentences.zh: 对，笨脑筋。

sentences.en: Now we have a man that just refuses to lower the Fed rate, just refuses to do it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有一个拒绝降低美联储利率的人，就是拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: And he's not a smart person.
sentences.zh: 而且他不是个聪明人。

sentences.en: I don't even think he's that political.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不认为他那么有政治性。

sentences.en: I think he hates me, but that's OK.
sentences.zh: 我想他恨我，但没关系。

sentences.en: You know, he should.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他应该的。

sentences.en: He should.
sentences.zh: 他应该的。

sentences.en: I call him every name in the book, trying to get him to do something.
sentences.zh: 我用你能想到的所有名字骂他，试图让他做点什么。

sentences.en: I've been nice to him.
sentences.zh: 我对一直他很好。

sentences.en: We're not seeing President Trump talk about the Fed as being a steward of the economy and, you know, someone keeping the economy on track.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到特朗普总统将美联储视为经济的管家，你知道，是一个让经济保持正轨的人。

sentences.en: But rather, it's in opposition to the president.
sentences.zh: 相反，它是与总统对立的。

sentences.en: So this really reached a climax on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 所以这在周二晚上真正达到了高潮。

sentences.en: So President Trump, he's sitting in the Oval Office with House Republicans.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普总统坐在椭圆形办公室里，与众议院共和党人在一起。

sentences.en: They're not meeting to talk about Powell.
sentences.zh: 他们开会不是为了谈论鲍威尔。

sentences.en: And yet, you know, this is Trump's favorite topic.
sentences.zh: 然而，你知道，这是特朗普最喜欢的话题。

sentences.en: And it comes up and he starts bashing the Fed chair.
sentences.zh: 它被提出来了，他开始抨击美联储主席。

sentences.en: And he's asking around, you know, saying, should I fire him?
sentences.zh: 他四处打听，你知道，说，我应该解雇他吗？

sentences.en: Should I not?
sentences.zh: 我不该解雇他吗？

sentences.en: He's polling these House Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他在对这些众议院共和党人进行民意测验。

sentences.en: Should I fire the Fed chair?
sentences.zh: 我应该解雇美联储主席吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And in all of these exchanges, he whips out this draft letter that he has actually firing Powell.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些交流中，他掏出了这封实际上要解雇鲍威尔的草稿信。

sentences.en: Now, this is not something that he has sent.
sentences.zh: 现在，这不是他已经发送的东西。

sentences.en: He's not even saying that he is going to send it.
sentences.zh: 他甚至没有说他要发送它。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is that he clearly has it at the ready.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，他显然已经准备好了。

sentences.en: And that's a real escalation in his threats against the chair.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他对主席威胁的升级。

sentences.en: And I think just for context, it's important to note that throughout history, presidents have always bashed on their Fed chairs.
sentences.zh: 我认为就背景而言，重要的是要注意到，历史上总统总是抨击他们的美联储主席。

sentences.en: They're a very useful scapegoat in that sense because they do operate independently from the White House.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，他们是一个非常有用的替罪羊，因为他们确实独立于白宫运作。

sentences.en: But I think the relentlessness of his attacks has really stood out.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他攻击的无情确实很突出。

sentences.en: And we should just say the reason why the president, why any president wants control of the interest rate
sentences.zh: 我们应该说一下总统、任何总统想要控制利率的原因

sentences.en: is because the interest rate is this accelerant or de-accelerant of economic activity.
sentences.zh: 是因为利率是经济活动的加速器或减速器。

sentences.en: And just to be really wonky about it, the Fed can raise interest rates when it's worried about inflation,
sentences.zh: 说得极其专业一点，当美联储担心通货膨胀时，它可以提高利率，

sentences.en: higher prices, because that will slow the economy down and help bring prices down.
sentences.zh: 价格上涨，因为那会放缓经济并有助于拉低价格。

sentences.en: Or the Fed can lower rates when it's worried about a recession because that's a way to stimulate economic activity.
sentences.zh: 或者当美联储担心经济衰退时，它可以降低利率，因为那是刺激经济活动的一种方式。

sentences.en: The interest rate, in short, is this very unique tool, weapon, whatever you want to call it.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，利率是一个非常独特的工具、武器，无论你想怎么称呼它。

sentences.en: And if you're the most powerful person in the world, you don't want that.
sentences.zh: 如果你是世界上最有权势的人，你不会想要这个。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: The Fed pulls up on a lever or pulls down on that lever.
sentences.zh: 美联储拉起一个杠杆或按下那个杠杆。

sentences.en: And that has a widespread impact on how people spend throughout the economy,
sentences.zh: 这效应对人们在整个经济中的消费方式产生了广泛的影响，

sentences.en: whether businesses decide to invest more, whether they decide to pull back, whether they hire or they fire workers.
sentences.zh: 无论是企业决定增加投资，还是决定撤回，无论是雇佣还是解雇工人。

sentences.en: So that's why President Trump wants it so badly.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么特朗普总统如此渴望得到它。

sentences.en: But that's also why the Fed is acting so cautiously here, because they know if they make the wrong move, they could potentially be guiding the economy in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么美联储在这里表现得如此谨慎，因为他们知道如果他们走错了一步，他们可能会把经济引导向错误的方向。

sentences.en: So, Colby, how exactly did this relationship become so testy, name-cally, at times ugly?
sentences.zh: 所以，科尔比，这段关系究竟是怎么变得如此暴躁、充满辱骂、有时甚至是丑陋的？

sentences.en: And I guess we should say one-sidedly ugly.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该说是单方面的丑陋。

sentences.en: It's not like Chairman Powell is calling Trump names.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔主席又没有给特朗普起绰号。

sentences.en: And I ask that question because Trump appointed Jay Powell to the job of running the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 我问这个问题是因为特朗普任命杰伊·鲍威尔担任管理美联储的职务。

sentences.en: So at one point, he clearly liked him enough to give him the job.
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时候，他显然很喜欢他，足以把这份工作交给他。

sentences.en: So what is the story of how we got from there to here?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是如何从那时走到现在的故事是什么呢？

sentences.en: So their relationship stretches back to November 2017.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的关系可以追溯到2017年11月。

sentences.en: That's when Trump nominates Powell to be the next Fed chair.
sentences.zh: 那是特朗普提名鲍威尔担任下一任美联储主席的时候。

sentences.en: And in doing so, he broke with tradition, actually, because most presidents, they end up keeping on their predecessor's Fed chair.
sentences.zh: 在这样做的时候，他实际上打破了传统，因为大多数总统最终都会留任他们前任的美联储主席。

sentences.en: And that's something he decided not to.
sentences.zh: 那是他决定不这么做的事情。

sentences.en: That was Janet Yellen.
sentences.zh: 那是珍妮特·耶伦。

sentences.en: It was Janet Yellen who was appointed by President Obama.
sentences.zh: 正是由奥巴马总统任命的珍妮特·耶伦。

sentences.en: And so she served only one term.
sentences.zh: 所以她只任职了一届。

sentences.en: And what exactly does Trump like about Powell?
sentences.zh: 特朗普究竟喜欢鲍威尔什么？

sentences.en: He's a Republican.
sentences.zh: 他是共和党人。

sentences.en: He is wealthy.
sentences.zh: 他很富有。

sentences.en: And he is seen as a pragmatist and a centriSt.
sentences.zh: 他被视为一个务实主义者和温和派。

sentences.en: And so he fit the bill in a lot of ways for the president.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面他很符合总统的要求。

sentences.en: As president, there are a few decisions more important than nominating leaders of integrity and good judgment to hold trusted positions.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，没有多少决定比提名具有正直和良好判断力的领导人担任受信任的职位更重要。

sentences.en: And I always think back to the announcement in the Rose Garden.
sentences.zh: 我总是回想起在玫瑰园的那个宣布。

sentences.en: And few of those trusted positions are more important than the chairman of the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 而在那些受信任的职位中，没有几个比美联储主席更重要。

sentences.en: When President Trump announces that he's picking Powell to be his chair.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统宣布他选择鲍威尔担任他的主席时。

sentences.en: I am confident that Jay has the wisdom and leadership to guide our economy through any challenges that our great economy may face.
sentences.zh: 我相信杰伊拥有智慧和领导力，能够引导我们的经济度过我们伟大经济可能面临的任何挑战。

sentences.en: And he has all these nice things to say about him.
sentences.zh: 他对他赞不绝口。

sentences.en: He calls him smart.
sentences.zh: 他称他很聪明。

sentences.en: He says he's committed.
sentences.zh: 他说他很有奉献精神。

sentences.en: He says he's strong and would be this wise steward of the Fed.
sentences.zh: 他说他很坚强，将成为美联储明智的管家。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. President, for the faith.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您，总统先生，感谢您的信任。

sentences.en: And, you know, in accepting the nomination,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在接受提名时，

sentences.en: Chair Powell talks about the objectivity he's going to bring to the role.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔主席谈到了他将为这个角色带来的客观性。

sentences.en: And I'm committed to making decisions with objectivity based on the best available evidence in the longstanding tradition of monetary policy independence.
sentences.zh: 我致力于遵循货币政策独立性的悠久传统，根据现有最佳证据客观地做出决策。

sentences.en: Mr. President, thank you again for this extraordinary opportunity to serve the American people.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，再次感谢您给予我为美国人民服务的非凡机会。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And you really get a sense that he understands the position that he's about to step into here.
sentences.zh: 你真的能感觉到他理解了他即将踏入的这个职位。

sentences.en: And we, as omniscient storytellers, can tell that the seeds of a future conflict have been laid.
sentences.zh: 而我们，作为无所不知的叙述者，可以看出未来冲突的种子已经埋下。

sentences.en: Independence, on the one hand, and strong person that I want in the job for me, on the other.
sentences.zh: 一方面是独立性，另一方面是我想要为我工作的坚强的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: We have our main characters.
sentences.zh: 我们有了我们的主要角色。

sentences.en: And I think the timing of this is really important because Powell takes over in February 2018.
sentences.zh: 我认为这的时机非常重要，因为鲍威尔在2018年2月接任。

sentences.en: This is right around the time that Trump embarks on his first trade war, where he's putting tariffs on Chinese imports.
sentences.zh: 这正是特朗普开始他的第一场贸易战的时候，他对中国进口商品加征关税。

sentences.en: And the Fed is raising interest rates.
sentences.zh: 而美联储正在提高利率。

sentences.en: But tensions don't really start boiling over until July, when President Trump starts to be more vocal about his misgivings about what the Fed is doing.
sentences.zh: 但紧张局势直到7月才真正开始沸腾，当时特朗普总统开始对美联储正在做的事情表现出更多的不满。

sentences.en: What is he saying?
sentences.zh: 他在说什么？

sentences.en: I put a very good man in the Fed.
sentences.zh: 我在美联储安插了一个非常好的人。

sentences.en: I don't necessarily agree with it because he's raising interest rates.
sentences.zh: 我并不一定赞同这一点，因为他正在提高利率。

sentences.en: I'm not saying that I agree with it.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说我同意这一点。

sentences.en: So he's starting out relatively benign.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始时相对温和。

sentences.en: I'm not thrilled because, you know, we go up and every time you go up, they want to raise rates again.
sentences.zh: 我并不激动，因为，你知道，我们上升了，每次你上升，他们就想再次提高利率。

sentences.en: And I don't really, I am not happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我真的不，我对这很不高兴。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I'm letting them do what they feel is beSt.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我让他们做他们认为最好的事情。

sentences.en: He's saying, you know, I'm not really thrilled with what they're doing here.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，我对他们在这里所做的事情并不是真的很激动。

sentences.en: I don't really think they should be raising interest rates.
sentences.zh: 我真的不认为他们应该提高利率。

sentences.en: But he doesn't do anything or say anything that seems like he's, like, coming after their independence in any way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 但他没有做任何事或说任何话让人觉得他是在以任何方式、形状或形式来挑战他们的独立性。

sentences.en: You know, the attacks really start to escalate as we get into the fall.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们进入秋季时，攻击确实开始升级了。

sentences.en: I think the Fed is out of control.
sentences.zh: 我认为美联储失控了。

sentences.en: I think what they're doing is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们做的事情是错的。

sentences.en: He says the Fed has gone crazy.
sentences.zh: 他说美联储已经疯了。

sentences.en: They're out of control with these interest rate increases.
sentences.zh: 他们加息加得失控了。

sentences.en: No, no, my biggest threat is the Fed, because the Fed is raising rates too faSt.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我最大的威胁是美联储，因为美联储加息太快了。

sentences.en: And things start to really take a turn in December when he was asking around whether he has the legal authority to fire the chair.
sentences.zh: 事情在12月开始真正发生变化，当时他到处打听自己是否有法定权力解雇美联储主席。

sentences.en: And these conversations end up becoming public.
sentences.zh: 而这些对话最终公之于众。

sentences.en: And it leads Stephen Mnuchin, the Treasury Secretary at the time, to have to go out there and assure financial markets in the world
sentences.zh: 这导致时任财政部长史蒂芬·姆努钦不得不站出来，向全球金融市场保证

sentences.en: that the president isn't about to get rid of his Fed chair.
sentences.zh: 总统并不打算撤换美联储主席。

sentences.en: You know, he says something along the lines of the president isn't happy with what Powell's doing here, but he kind of understands that he's sticking around.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的大意是说，总统对鲍威尔在这里的做法很不满意，但他大概也明白鲍威尔会留任。

sentences.en: I mean, just to step back and try to understand what's really happening here between Trump and Powell.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们退一步想想，试着去理解特朗普和鲍威尔之间到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Clearly, there's not just a divergence about whether the interest rate should be raised or cut in this
sentences.zh: 很显然，双方的分歧不仅仅在于此时此刻究竟应该加息还是降息，

sentences.en: moment, that's clear enough, there seems to be a divergence over the role of the Fed and who should control it.
sentences.zh: 这一点已经够清楚了，他们似乎在美联储的角色以及谁应该控制美联储的问题上也存在分歧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: I think Trump sees the Fed as an institution that can act at his behest, that can help him fulfill his economic and political ambitions.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普把美联储视为一个可以听命于他的机构，认为它可以帮他实现经济和政治上的野心。

sentences.en: For the Fed, what they're trying to do is steer the economy in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 对美联储而言，他们努力要做的是引导经济朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: And they're doing so without the influence of the White House.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的行动不受白宫的影响。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There is this inherent tension.
sentences.zh: 这种天然的张力是客观存在的。

sentences.en: The Fed is trying to manage the long-term health of the economy.
sentences.zh: 美联储试图管理经济的长期健康状况。

sentences.en: The president, for obvious reasons, wants a strong economy during his or her tenure.
sentences.zh: 出于显而易见的原因，总统希望在自己任内经济强劲。

sentences.en: And what's good politically for the president in the short term, in many cases, low interest rates, isn't necessarily good for the economy in the long term if you are the Fed.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，短期内对总统在政治上有利的东西——比如低利率，站在美联储的角度来看，未必对长期经济有利。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And I think it's important here to unpack how the Fed goes about making its decisions because it's not up to one person.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里很重要的一点是，要剖析美联储是如何做出决策的，因为这不是一个人说了算的。

sentences.en: It's a consensus-driven organization.
sentences.zh: 这是一个依靠共识驱动的机构。

sentences.en: So there is a committee of 12 officials.
sentences.zh: 因此有一个由12名官员组成的委员会。

sentences.en: They vote on policy at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 他们在任何既定时刻都对政策进行投票。

sentences.en: So they need to be certain that this is the right thing for the economy in order to get there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须确信这对经济来说是正确的事情，才会做出决定。

sentences.en: And this isn't something that is just like flicking a switch like President Trump has kind of talked about.
sentences.zh: 这可不是像特朗普总统之前说的那样，随随便便就能像拨开关一样简单。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's a carefully and slowly considered process that it sounds like everyone at the Fed sees as deeply independent of politics.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经过仔细且缓慢权衡的过程，听起来美联储的每个人都认为它与政治保持着深刻的独立性。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's very deliberate.
sentences.zh: 这是非常审慎的。

sentences.en: And the idea here is that a central bank that's independent is going to put the economy on the best footing possible because they're not worried about the whims of a
sentences.zh: 这里的核心理念是，一个独立的中央能够让经济处于尽可能最佳的基础之上，因为他们不必担忧某个

sentences.en: political party.
sentences.zh: 政党的反复无常。

sentences.en: They're not worried about an election cycle.
sentences.zh: 他们不必担忧选举周期。

sentences.en: They are chiefly focused on making sure they're prioritizing that inflation is staying slow and stable and the labor market is healthy.
sentences.zh: 他们的主要精力集中在确保将首要任务放在保持通胀低迷稳定以及劳动力市场健康上。

sentences.en: And those two goals are what gives people confidence that the economy is in good hands.
sentences.zh: 正是这两大目标赋予了人们对经济交托在好手里的信心。

sentences.en: So how does that tension continue to play out in Trump's first term?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种张力在特朗普的第一任期内是如何持续上演的呢？

sentences.en: So I think everything gets overshadowed at some point by the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，在某种程度上，所有事情都被大流行给盖过去了。

sentences.en: Basically, the entire world shuts down.
sentences.zh: 基本上，全世界都停摆了。

sentences.en: The economy is in free fall.
sentences.zh: 经济陷入自由落体。

sentences.en: Financial markets are seizing up.
sentences.zh: 金融市场陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: At that point, tension between these two individuals somewhat evaporates because we're in a crisis fighting mode.
sentences.zh: 在那个时刻，这两人之间的紧张关系在某种程度上烟消云散了，因为我们正处于抗击危机的模式中。

sentences.en: So the Fed knows exactly what to do in a crisis situation like this.
sentences.zh: 所以美联储非常清楚在这样的危机局势下该做什么。

sentences.en: They cut interest rates to zero.
sentences.zh: 他们将利率降至零。

sentences.en: They're wading into financial markets.
sentences.zh: 他们大举介入金融市场。

sentences.en: They're buying unlimited government bonds.
sentences.zh: 他们无限制地购买政府债券。

sentences.en: They're doing everything in their power in order to stabilize the situation.
sentences.zh: 他们竭尽全力来稳定局势。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration pushed through two big stimulus packages to prop up the economy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府推出了两项大型刺激计划来支撑经济。

sentences.en: And then Biden came into the office and did another big package as well to shore up growth.
sentences.zh: 接着拜登入主白宫，又推出了另一项大型计划来提振增长。

sentences.en: And this is when Powell makes this big miscalculation that he even concedes is an error on his end.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，鲍威尔做出了这个重大误判，他甚至承认这是他自己的一大失误。

sentences.en: It happens in 2021 when Biden is in office.
sentences.zh: 这发生在2021年，当时拜登在任。

sentences.en: And this mistake ends up haunting the Fed and eventually influencing his relationship with Trump now.
sentences.zh: 这个错误最终成了美联储挥之不去的阴影，并最终影响了他现在与特朗普的关系。

sentences.en: Well, just explain that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: You know, supply chains are all gummed up.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，供应链全部堵塞了。

sentences.en: There's shortages in goods everywhere at exactly the moment that all this money is coming to the system.
sentences.zh: 就在大量资金涌入系统的同时，各地的商品都出现短缺。

sentences.en: And that just helped to bid up prices over time.
sentences.zh: 这无形中推高了价格。

sentences.en: So as the situation starts unfolding,
sentences.zh: 因此，随着局势开始演变，

sentences.en: Powell is faced with this big question.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔面临着一个重大的问题。

sentences.en: Is the inflation that started to show through, is that temporary or is that persistent?
sentences.zh: 开始显现的通胀到底是暂时的，还是持续性的？

sentences.en: Inflation at these levels is, of course, a cause for concern.
sentences.zh: 达到这个水平的通胀，当然是令人担忧的理由。

sentences.en: Powell ends up putting his stake in the ground on inflation in August of 2021.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔最终在2021年8月就通胀问题表明了立场。

sentences.en: But that concern is tempered by a number of factors that that suggests that these elevated readings are likely to prove temporary.
sentences.zh: 但这种担忧被一些因素所缓和，这些因素表明这些高企的数据很可能只是暂时的。

sentences.en: He makes this big speech in front of global policymakers and the world, frankly, where he says this inflation is temporary.
sentences.zh: 他在全球决策者和坦白说全世界面前发表了这篇重要演讲，他在演讲中称这种通胀是暂时的。

sentences.en: We're going to keep interest rates low in this environment.
sentences.zh: 在这种环境下，我们将保持低利率。

sentences.en: And that ends up being the wrong call, because what ends up happening is that inflation really starts to reaccelerate from that point on.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这是一个错误的判断，因为接下来发生的是，通胀从那时起真正开始重新加速。

sentences.en: And the Fed, because it's slow to kind of catch on to the extent of the problem, inflation ends up spiraling as high as 9 percent in the summer of
sentences.zh: 而美联储由于反应迟钝，未能察觉问题的严重性，导致通胀在2022年
夏天飙升至高达9%。

sentences.en: So eventually, you know, after a series of historic interest rate increases, the Fed does get a handle on inflation.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，你知道的，在一系列历史性的加息之后，美联储确实控制住了通胀。

sentences.en: But I think the long-term lesson here for the Fed and for Chair Powell in particular is not to be complacent about it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于美联储、尤其是鲍威尔主席而言，这其中的长期教训就是绝不能掉以轻心。

sentences.en: Because if they misread the inflation situation, they let things get out of hand, then they're going to be potentially facing down a much worse problem later down the line.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们误读了通胀形势，任由事情失控，那么他们在未来很可能将不得不面对一个严重得多的问题。

sentences.en: And just to be very clear for Powell, the lesson is do not for a second take your eye off inflation.
sentences.zh: 为了对鲍威尔说得更明白一点，这个教训就是：一分一秒都不能把视线从通胀上移开。

sentences.en: And the minute you see inflation, slay the inflation dragon.
sentences.zh: 一旦看到通胀抬头，就要斩断通胀这条恶龙。

sentences.en: That's the lesson from this whole period.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个时期得出的教训。

sentences.en: And it's something that we see the Fed and Chair Powell bring up time and again in Trump's second term in the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们在特朗普的第二个白宫任期内，多次看到美联储和鲍威尔主席重提这个教训。

sentences.en: And that lesson makes an already bad relationship even worse.
sentences.zh: 而这个教训让本就糟糕的关系变得更加雪上加霜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜之一“连线”的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”和“字母方块”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有种叫做联觉的奇妙特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: So, Colby, talk about how this already not good relationship in term one further devolves in term two and how this lesson that Jay Powell has observed somehow fits into it.
sentences.zh: 那么，科尔比，聊聊在第一任期本就不融洽的关系是如何在第二任期进一步恶化的，以及杰伊·鲍威尔所观察到的这个教训是如何与之契合的。

sentences.en: So it starts to devolve even before President Trump is back in the White House.
sentences.zh: 这种恶化在特朗普总统重返白宫之前就已经开始了。

sentences.en: So on the campaign trail, he is attacking the chair for lowering interest rates, which they started to do in September, just a couple months before the election.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，他一直在抨击美联储主席降息，而他们确实在9月（就在选举前几个月）开始降息了。

sentences.en: And why are they lowering interest rates?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要降息呢？

sentences.en: So they're doing this because they wanted to support the economy.
sentences.zh: 他们这么做是因为他们想要支持经济。

sentences.en: At this time, inflation had receded from some of those like post-pandemic peak, and the labor market was starting to cool off.
sentences.zh: 此时，通胀已经从疫情后的某些峰值回落，劳动力市场也开始冷却。

sentences.en: And this was the big first rate reduction that we had seen in the kind of post-pandemic period.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在后疫情时期看到的首次大幅降息。

sentences.en: And in Trump's eyes, this was entirely political.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普看来，这完全是出于政治目的。

sentences.en: They were doing this to kind of tip the scales towards Kamala Harris's campaign to juice the economy basically before all the voters descended to the voting booth.
sentences.zh: 他们这么做是为了把天平倾向卡玛拉·哈里斯的竞选团队，基本上就是在选民涌向投票站之前给经济注入兴奋剂。

sentences.en: So in Trump's mind, if the interest rate is being cut when he is a candidate for president and Biden is the incumbent and Harris is running, then it's being done in some ways
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普看来，既然在他作为总统候选人、拜登在任且哈里斯参选时降息，那么某种程度上这就是在

sentences.en: to screw with him.
sentences.zh: 跟他作对。

sentences.en: And also it was like the magnitude that I think pissed him off even more.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为更让他恼火的是降息的幅度。

sentences.en: Typically, the Fed moves in these like quarter point increments, and they ended up moving much faster than that for the first cut.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，美联储的调息幅度是四分之一个百分点，而他们在第一次降息时的行动要激进得多。

sentences.en: And then the Fed ended up cutting interest rates again in November.
sentences.zh: 随后美联储在11月又再次降息。

sentences.en: They cut interest rates in December.
sentences.zh: 他们在12月又降了息。

sentences.en: And then Trump comes back to the White House, and then the Fed presses pause on all of it.
sentences.zh: 接着特朗普重返白宫，然后美联储按下了这一切的暂停键。

sentences.en: They say, we're going to wait and see, and we need to take stock of what President Trump has planned for this economy.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们要拭目以待，我们需要评估特朗普总统为这个经济体做好了什么计划。

sentences.en: Right, because Trump has a lot planned for the economy in the second term.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为特朗普为第二任期的经济做好了大量规划。

sentences.en: Once he gets in, he is issuing executive orders on immigration.
sentences.zh: 他一上台，就开始颁布关于移民的行政令。

sentences.en: He is levying tariffs on countries across the world.
sentences.zh: 他对世界各国的商品征收关税。

sentences.en: Doge is cutting tens of thousands of federal jobs.
sentences.zh: 政府效率部（Doge）正在裁减数以万计的联邦工作岗位。

sentences.en: The things Trump campaigned on, he's now doing.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在竞选时承诺的事情，他现在都在兑现。

sentences.en: I'm hearing you say that the Fed looking at all of this is saying, that's a lot.
sentences.zh: 我听出来你的意思是，美联储看着这一切，觉得事情有点多。

sentences.en: We need to see how it filters through the economy before we can make any educated decision about the interest rate.
sentences.zh: 我们需要观察这些政策如何传导至整个经济，然后才能对利率做出任何理性的决策。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Tariffs, for instance, the thinking there is that it's going to raise inflation at the same time that it slows down growth.
sentences.zh: 以关税为例，大家的普遍想法是，它既会推高通胀，同时又会放缓经济增长。

sentences.en: The immigration crackdown, that's going to shrink the labor force, and it also could mean higher inflation as well.
sentences.zh: 打击非法移民，这会导致劳动力规模缩减，同时也可能意味着更高的通胀。

sentences.en: You also have tax cuts layered on top of that and deregulation.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，还有叠加的减税和放松监管政策。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of moving parts.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有许多动态变动的因素。

sentences.en: And the Fed, they move slowly.
sentences.zh: 而美联储的行动一向缓慢。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of time to gain consensus amongst all the various officials to get to the right point and know which direction to go in terms of interest rates.
sentences.zh: 要在各个官员之间达成共识、找到正确的节点并明确利率的发展方向，需要花费大量时间。

sentences.en: And they don't want to rush.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不想仓促行事。

sentences.en: And their argument here is that the economy is on solid enough footing, that there's no urgency here.
sentences.zh: 他们给出的理由是，经济基础足够坚实，因此目前没有任何紧迫性。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Trump is like, we got to cut interest rates now.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特朗普的态度则是：我们现在就得降息。

sentences.en: I want lower borrowing costs.
sentences.zh: 我想要更低的借贷成本。

sentences.en: It's going to be better for my economic agenda.
sentences.zh: 这会对我的经济议程更有利。

sentences.en: Deja vu.
sentences.zh: 似曾相识。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Deja vu.
sentences.zh: 似曾相识。

sentences.en: And what's still very much at the heart of this perhaps irretrievably dysfunctional relationship is Trump wants Jay Powell to lower interest rates.
sentences.zh: 而这段或许已无可救药的失调关系的核心，依然是特朗普想要杰伊·鲍威尔降低利率。

sentences.en: Powell isn't giving into Trump's demands.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔并没有向特朗普的要求妥协。

sentences.en: He's keeping them exactly where they are.
sentences.zh: 他把利率维持在原地不动。

sentences.en: But I wonder, just based purely on the economic situation we're in now, whether Trump has any point here that may make him right,
sentences.zh: 但我在想，仅从我们目前所处的经济形势来看，特朗普是否有某些道理让他显得是对的，

sentences.en: even if it might seem to Powell like his motivations are wrong.
sentences.zh: 哪怕在鲍威尔看来他的动机可能是错的。

sentences.en: So, I mean, he's right in the sense that inflation has come down over time, that we are in a situation
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从通胀随时间推移已经下降的角度来看，他是对的；相比几年前，

sentences.en: in which compared to where we were a couple years ago, price pressures are a lot more muted and the economy is looking okay.
sentences.zh: 我们现在所处的环境中，价格压力已经温和得多，经济看起来也还不错。

sentences.en: And in an environment like that, it makes total sense that the Fed would be cutting interest rates from these relatively elevated levels and providing some support.
sentences.zh: 在这样的环境下，美联储从相对高位的利率水平开始降息并提供一些支持，完全是合情合理的。

sentences.en: But the problem is, is that the policies that he has laid out are inflationary.
sentences.zh: 但问题在于，他所制定的政策是会推高通胀的。

sentences.en: That's at least what economists and policymakers think is the case.
sentences.zh: 至少经济学家和决策者们是这么认为的。

sentences.en: And when you have a situation where you think inflation is coming down the pipe, you're not going to lower interest rates now if you eventually have to reverse course
sentences.zh: 当你面临一种预期通胀即将卷土重来的局势时，如果未来由于消费价格再次显著上涨而不得不扭转方向，你现在就不会去降低利率。

sentences.en: later because consumer prices start rising again in a significant way.
sentences.zh: 如果在未来由于消费价格再次显著上涨而不得不扭转方向，你现在就不会去降低利率。

sentences.en: And specifically when we say that Trump's policies are inflationary, I'm assuming we mean his tariffs in particular.
sentences.zh: 具体说到特朗普的政策会推高通胀，我猜我们指的主要是他的关税政策。

sentences.en: It's tariffs in particular, but I also think it's immigration restrictions.
sentences.zh: 主要是关税，但我认为还有移民限制政策。

sentences.en: When you, you know, cut back the supply of labor and the economy, that means fewer workers.
sentences.zh: 当你在经济中削减劳动力供给时，那就意味着工人变少了。

sentences.en: That could potentially mean, you know, companies have to provide higher wages to get people in the door again.
sentences.zh: 这潜在地意味着，企业可能不得不提供更高的工资才能把人招进门。

sentences.en: So, there are reasons to think that inflation has not been vanquished entirely here.
sentences.zh: 因此，有理由认为通胀在这里并未被彻底消灭。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And as we know, that is the very thing Jay Powell is most anxious about not having done vanquishing inflation.
sentences.zh: 如我们所知，这正是杰伊·宝威尔最焦虑、最担心没能彻底消灭的东西——通胀。

sentences.en: That's the lesson that is being internalized here at the Fed and what's fueling this debate that's ongoing amongst officials at the current moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是美联储内部正在内化吸收的教训，也是点燃目前官员之间持续辩论的导火索。

sentences.en: So, Jay Powell isn't alone in wanting to be patient in terms of cutting interest rates.
sentences.zh: 所以，在降息问题上主张保持耐心的人里，杰伊·鲍威尔并不孤单。

sentences.en: There's a large group of policymakers that are also kind of in his corner, but other officials have taken a different view that are slightly more aligned
sentences.zh: 有一大批决策者也站在他这一边，不过其他官员则持不同观点，他们的立场与特朗普政府当前的诉求

sentences.en: with what the Trump administration is at here.
sentences.zh: 更加契合一些。

sentences.en: So, what the heart of the debate comes down to is how to view inflation caused by tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论的核心其实在于，如何看待关税引起的通货膨胀。

sentences.en: We go back to the same kind of question that we grappled with after the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了疫情之后纠缠过的那类问题。

sentences.en: Is this inflation temporary or is it persistent?
sentences.zh: 这种通胀是暂时的，还是持续的？

sentences.en: Now, the thinking here amongst this cohort of officials is that tariffs are actually going to lead to only a temporary burst in inflation.
sentences.zh: 现在，这批官员的想法是，关税实际上只会导致通胀的暂时爆发。

sentences.en: So, the case that this is temporary rests on this assumption that these price pressures are going to come through, but they're not going to feed on themselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，认为这是暂时的观点基于这样一种假设：这些价格压力会出现，但不会自我恶化。

sentences.en: So, back during the post-pandemic period, what we ended up seeing was that these price pressures broadened out.
sentences.zh: 所以在疫情后的一段时间里，我们最终看到的是这些价格压力范围扩大了。

sentences.en: So, it wasn't just in the supply chain disrupted sectors.
sentences.zh: 所以，它不仅限于供应链中断的行业。

sentences.en: It spread well beyond that into services, into areas that were not directly impacted by the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 它远远蔓延到了服务业，蔓延到了没有直接受疫情冲击的领域。

sentences.en: And the thinking of this group of officials is that it's going to stay pretty contained.
sentences.zh: 这群官员的想法是，这种情况将保持在相当可控的范围内。

sentences.en: And that means that over time, it's not going to lead to inflation, you know, getting out of control again.
sentences.zh: 这意味着随着时间的推移，它不会导致通胀，你知道的，再次失控。

sentences.en: Now, that's really, I think, where the Trump administration is at in terms of what is going to happen to inflation over time.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为这正是特朗普政府对通胀随时间推移会发生什么的想法所在。

sentences.en: But what is preventing the bulk of the Fed from moving in that same direction is the fact that they don't want to make the same mistake again twice.
sentences.zh: 但阻止美联储大部分人朝同一方向行动的，是他们不想连续两次犯同样的错误。

sentences.en: They want more data.
sentences.zh: 他们想要更多的数据。

sentences.en: They want to take a little bit more time.
sentences.zh: 他们想多花一点时间。

sentences.en: They want to have more certainty than otherwise would be the case had they not just made this error a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 他们希望比几年前没有犯过这个错误时拥有更高的确定性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And we should say, you and I are talking after the government just released data, monthly inflation data, that showed that prices rose 2.7% in May compared with May a year ago,
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，你我在政府刚刚发布数据后进行交谈，这是显示5月份价格同比上涨2.7%的月度通胀数据，

sentences.en: which is to say that if you're at the Fed and you're in the Jay Powell camp of wait and see, you've just seen data that suggests that prices are continuing to rise.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你身处美联储，属于杰罗姆·鲍威尔的观望阵营，你刚刚看到的数据表明价格仍在继续上涨。

sentences.en: And your instinct is probably not to defer to the Trump camp that says, cut interest rates, roll the dice, hope it's temporary.
sentences.zh: 你的直觉可能不是顺从特朗普阵营的说法——降息、碰碰运气、指望它是暂时的。

sentences.en: Your fear is that it's not temporary.
sentences.zh: 你担心它不是暂时的。

sentences.en: And your evidence, in part, is this new data.
sentences.zh: 你的部分证据就是这组新数据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And the data showed clear evidence that tariffs are starting to impact consumer prices.
sentences.zh: 数据显示出明显的证据，表明关税开始对消费品价格产生影响。

sentences.en: And I think what's worrisome about this is that this is like the early stages of this.
sentences.zh: 我认为令人担忧的是，这还只是早期的阶段。

sentences.en: So the expectation for economists and policymakers is that as the summer kind of continues, this is just only going to kind of intensify as we get new data.
sentences.zh: 因此，经济学家和政策制定者的预期是，随着夏季的延续，随着我们获得新的数据，这种状况只会加剧。

sentences.en: And so that puts the Fed in a really uncomfortable position.
sentences.zh: 这就把美联储置于一个非常尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: How is it going to justify cutting interest rates when price pressures are moving away from their stated goal and the economy is still kind of doing OK?
sentences.zh: 当价格压力背离他们既定的目标，而经济表现还算可以时，他们将如何为降息辩护？

sentences.en: It doesn't seem like the rationale is really there just yet.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，这种理由似乎还不够充分。

sentences.en: And so I think that's why we can broadly expect them to see them extend this whole wait and see approach at least for the next couple of months.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是为什么我们可以大致预期他们会延长这种观望态度，至少在接下来的几个月里是这样。

sentences.en: Which, of course, explains why the president is now so evidently furious at Powell, so much so that he waves that draft letter saying, you're fired in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 这当然解释了为什么总统现在对鲍威尔明显如此愤怒，以至于他在椭圆形办公室挥舞着那封写着“你被解雇了”的草拟信。

sentences.en: We should be careful and say he hasn't sent that letter.
sentences.zh: 我们应该谨慎地说，他还没有发出那封信。

sentences.en: It's therefore not official.
sentences.zh: 因此它还不是官方的。

sentences.en: But that raises the question, can Trump fire Jay Powell?
sentences.zh: 但这引发了一个问题：特朗普能解雇杰罗姆·鲍威尔吗？

sentences.en: So the president can't outright fire a Fed chair.
sentences.zh: 总统不能直接解雇美联储主席。

sentences.en: The rules stipulate that like once they're in that position and confirmed by the Senate, they're relatively protected here.
sentences.zh: 规则规定，一旦他们担任该职位并通过参议院确认，他们就会受到相对的保护。

sentences.en: And the only mechanism that the president has, which was just recently reestablished by the Supreme Court earlier
sentences.zh: 总统拥有的唯一机制——就在今年早些时候刚刚被最高法院重新确立——

sentences.en: this year, is that the president has to find cause in order to get rid of a Fed official.
sentences.zh: 是总统必须找到正当理由才能免职美联储官员。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You can't just fire him because you disagree with him.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅因为不同意他就解雇他。

sentences.en: You have to fire him because he took a bribe.
sentences.zh: 你必须因为他受贿而解雇他。

sentences.en: It can't be about a rate decision.
sentences.zh: 这不能与利率决定有关。

sentences.en: It has to be like severe misconduct or, you know, some kind of dereliction of duty.
sentences.zh: 它必须是严重的失职，或者，你知道的，某种渎职行为。

sentences.en: And that really raises the bar for Trump to find something in order to get Powell removed.
sentences.zh: 这确实提高了特朗普找到理由让鲍威尔下台的门槛。

sentences.en: One of the avenues that we have seen most recently is Republicans going after the Fed chair from renovations taking place at the central bank's headquarters down in D.C.
sentences.zh: 我们最近看到的途径之一是，共和党人针对华盛顿特区央行总部正在进行的翻修工程对美联储主席发难。

sentences.en: These are very costly.
sentences.zh: 这些费用非常高昂。

sentences.en: They've attracted a lot of attention at a time when there are cuts across the government.
sentences.zh: 在政府各部门都在削减开支的时候，它们引起了极大的关注。

sentences.en: And recently, there was an allegation that Chair Powell had lied to Congress about the extent of the plans.
sentences.zh: 最近有人指控鲍威尔主席就计划的规模对国会撒了谎。

sentences.en: And when legal experts kind of have pieced through these accusations, they have been concerned that
sentences.zh: 当法律专家仔细剖析这些指控时，他们一直担心

sentences.en: this is one of the ways in which the Trump administration is trying to build the case for cause.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府试图为寻找正当理由建立依据的方法之一。

sentences.en: Now, that's a really hard argument to build.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个很难构建的论点。

sentences.en: And I don't think a lot of people think it's going to be successful.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为很多人并不认为这会成功。

sentences.en: So what are the other options?
sentences.zh: 那么还有什么其他选择呢？

sentences.en: So the other options that the president has toyed with is naming Powell's successor early.
sentences.zh: 总统摆弄过的另一个选择是提前指定鲍威尔的继任者。

sentences.en: So Powell's term ends in May of 2026.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔的任期将于2026年5月结束。

sentences.en: And so the idea here is that by naming someone early and having them come out and talk about a very divergent, you know, path for interest rates or to put forward a very different
sentences.zh: 所以这里的想法是，通过提前任命某人，让他们出来谈论一条截然不同的利率道路，或者提出一种对经济的截然不同

sentences.en: view on the economy that more aligns with President Trump's, that that's a way for them to discredit
sentences.zh: 、更符合特朗普总统观点的看法，这是一种抹黑鲍威尔的方式

sentences.en: Powell and put more attention on whoever's going to be taking the reins in a couple of times.
sentences.zh: ，并将更多的注意力转移到将来某个时候接掌权柄的人身上。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It would kind of like it would kind of be like having two popes.
sentences.zh: 这有点像，这有点像是拥有两个教皇。

sentences.en: You'd almost have, in theory, two Fed chairs, one official, one kind of shadow.
sentences.zh: 理论上你几乎会有两个美联储主席，一个是官方的，一个是影子内阁式的。

sentences.en: And that is a recipe for disaster in terms of communication for the Fed, because what they rely on is that financial markets have an understanding of where they're
sentences.zh: 对于美联储的沟通来说，这简直是灾难的配方，因为他们所依赖的是金融市场对他们

sentences.en: going with interest rates and policy.
sentences.zh: 利率和政策走向的理解。

sentences.en: And that is what makes their policy setting effective.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点使他们的政策制定变得有效。

sentences.en: So if you have the same institution essentially speaking in completely divergent ways, that could lead to a really bad outcome where people don't know who to listen to.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果同一个机构本质上在以完全背道而驰的方式发声，那可能会导致一个非常糟糕的结果，即人们不知道该听谁的。

sentences.en: And so in a world where Trump does not get what he wants for the next many months, let's even,
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普在接下来的许多个月里都无法如愿的世界里，我们甚至可以

sentences.en: for the sake of argument, say he may not get a rate cut before Jay Powell's term is up next May.
sentences.zh: 为了论证起见，假设他在明年5月杰罗姆·鲍威尔任期结束前可能无法获得降息。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the president has the opportunity to put in place a replacement for Jay Powell.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，总统有机会为杰罗姆·鲍威尔安排一个替代者。

sentences.en: And I think we can presume it's going to be someone who agrees with the president that, generally speaking, interest rates should be cut.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可以推测，那将是一个同意总统观点的人，即总的来说，利率应该被下调。

sentences.en: What is it going to look like for us to have a Fed chairperson who may be in the mold of the rest of Trump's appointees to various government agencies,
sentences.zh: 如果我们有一个美联储主席，他可能带有特朗普对各政府机构的其他任命官员的模子，

sentences.en: who see their role as fulfilling his vision?
sentences.zh: 他们将自己的角色视为实现他的愿景，那会对我们意味着什么？

sentences.en: That's not what Jay Powell thought.
sentences.zh: 杰罗姆·鲍威尔可不是这么想的。

sentences.en: If we suddenly have a Fed chair who says, I wake up in the morning and my job is to see the economy as Trump sees it, what does that mean for us all?
sentences.zh: 如果我们突然有一个美联储主席说，我早上醒来，我的工作就是按照特朗普的眼光看待经济，这对我们所有人意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does that mean for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这对美国

sentences.en: economy and maybe even the global economy?
sentences.zh: 经济乃至全球经济意味着什么？

sentences.en: It's a big change.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的改变。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's a really worrying development, and it's something that people are already grappling with today.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是一个非常令人担忧的发展，而且人们今天已经在为此苦恼了。

sentences.en: This idea that this institution might not be this, like, beacon of credibility that it has always been.
sentences.zh: 这种机构可能不再是它一直以来的那座信誉灯塔的想法。

sentences.en: If you have someone leading the Fed who is being influenced by the White House, that really changes your perception about the decisions that that person is trying to usher through.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一个受白宫影响的美联储领导人，那真的会改变你对那个人试图推行的决定的看法。

sentences.zh: 美联储主席是谁，而我已经不信任他了。

sentences.en: And that's such a huge issue for whoever is in the role, because the role is based upon having the support of financial markets and being seen as a credible
sentences.zh: 对于担任这个角色的人来说，这是一个巨大的问题，因为这个角色是建立在获得金融市场支持并被视为一个有信誉的

sentences.en: individual, guiding the economy in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 、引导经济朝正确方向发展的个人的基础之上的。

sentences.en: What that investor was basically telling you is that what Trump has done in bludgeoning Jay Powell the
sentences.zh: 那位投资者基本上是在告诉你，特朗普这些年来对杰罗姆·鲍威尔的猛烈抨击

sentences.zh: ，使得人们不可能再将他的下一个选择视为能够独立运作的人。

sentences.zh: 而利害关系从来没有像现在这样重大。

sentences.en: You could easily see a situation where we have higher inflation, a worse economic backdrop, and a person in the role who is not kind of willing

sentences.zh: 做出那些可能违背总统意愿但却有利于经济长期健康，而不是特朗普总统所关注的这些短期利益的艰难抉择。

sentences.en: health of the economy over these short-term gains that President Trump is focused on.
